policy.ranking_rule: rank is computed from SIGNAL columns only (eligibility gates first, then bootstrap CI lower bound, then p-value); staking columns are diagnostics and can never change rank
policy.luck_rule: ROI is re-measured with one-score games (margin <= 8) and blowouts (margin >= 25) removed; a signal that survives only on luck games is flagged
policy.blank_rule: an ungraded cell stays blank and is flagged; never inferred
